expectationScope: Explicit public HTTP projections and lifecycle adaptations; no private Context, generic private composer, or whole-upstream-suite pass claim.

cases.title: Request
cases.behavior: Retain log=log message and xxx=yyy on one request.
cases.reason: Replace Context.get/set with fixture-owned per-request state; no claim about the Context API.
cases.localScenario: Request and Response retain upstream state and header values

cases.title: Response
cases.behavior: JSON message=new response, x-custom-header=custom-header and zzz=xxx.
cases.reason: Observe public HTTP response and per-request state; original Context fields are not Utils APIs.
cases.localScenario: Request and Response retain upstream state and header values

cases.title: Response
cases.behavior: Non-async terminal returns a promise resolving JSON message=new response.
cases.reason: Use an explicit owned promise gate instead of an incidental setTimeout.
cases.localScenario: non-async handler returns an owned promise

cases.title: Should return 200 Response
cases.behavior: Request header x-header-foo=foo produces body foo; response x-header-bar=bar.
cases.reason: Use native Request headers and returned Response instead of Context accessors.
cases.localScenario: request and response header middleware preserve foo and bar

cases.title: Should return 200 Response
cases.behavior: First response terminates with 200 Hello; later middleware and terminal are not invoked.
cases.reason: Wire response retained; no assertion of private Context.finalized.
cases.localScenario: early response skips later middleware

cases.title: Should return 404 Response
cases.behavior: Passthrough reaches custom synchronous 404 onNotFound.
cases.reason: Wire status/body retained; Context.finalized has no Utils counterpart.
cases.localScenario: not found callback: sync

cases.title: Should return 404 Response - async handler
cases.behavior: Passthrough reaches custom asynchronous 404 onNotFoundAsync.
cases.reason: Wire status/body retained; Context.finalized has no Utils counterpart.
cases.localScenario: not found callback: async

cases.title: Should return 401 Response
cases.behavior: After downstream Hello, middleware replaces status/body with 401 Not authorized.
cases.reason: Hono explicitly assigns Context.res; Utils returns replacement. Both discard the intentionally abandoned response.
cases.localScenario: middleware replaces Hello with Not authorized and owns discarded body

cases.title: Should return 200 Response
cases.behavior: x-custom=foo written before next is visible to terminal body foo.
cases.reason: Wire status/body retained; Context.finalized has no Utils counterpart.
cases.localScenario: next sees request header written before dispatch

cases.title: Error on handler
cases.behavior: Synchronous throwing handler reaches mapper: 500 onError.
cases.reason: Use Hono.onError and Utils.catchErrors.map; Context.finalized is not a shared contract.
cases.localScenario: onError callback: sync

cases.title: Error on handler - async
cases.behavior: Synchronous throwing handler reaches asynchronous mapper: 500 onError.
cases.reason: Upstream async title describes mapper, not throwing handler. Use each public error-mapping API.
cases.localScenario: onError callback: async

cases.title: Run all the middlewares
cases.behavior: All three middleware append literal stack [0,1,2].
cases.reason: Provide finite terminal Hello to satisfy the public HTTP response contract.
cases.localScenario: all middleware enters in authored order

cases.title: Should throw multiple call error
cases.behavior: Two-layer repeated next rejects before a second terminal call.
cases.reason: Hono Error next() called multiple times and Utils TypeError more than once are independently asserted; error classes/messages deliberately differ.
cases.localScenario: repeated next rejects once: nested

cases.title: should get executed order one by one
cases.behavior: Called [true,true,true], order [1,2,3,4,5,6].
cases.reason: Supply finite terminal Hello; original private composition had no final response.
cases.localScenario: onion order matches all six literal steps

cases.title: should not get executed if previous next() not triggered
cases.behavior: Called [true,true], order [1,2,6]; third middleware not entered.
cases.reason: Original no-next middleware returned undefined; public HTTP port supplies owned 401 Not authorized instead of claiming unfinished Context parity.
cases.localScenario: lack next short-circuits with an owned 401 response

cases.title: should be able to be called twice
cases.behavior: One prepared app processes distinct requests with independent [1,2,3,4,5,6] arrays.
cases.reason: Request lifetime replaces caller-created Context lifetime.
cases.localScenario: reuse keeps separate request state and resets continuation ownership

cases.title: should create next functions that return a Promise
cases.behavior: All five actual next return values are Promises and joined.
cases.reason: Original middleware discards next promises and returns undefined. Public HTTP port returns/joins them to own completion; records actual next values without a promise-producing adapter.
cases.localScenario: plain middleware can return and await all five continuation promises

cases.title: should work with 0 middleware
cases.behavior: Empty middleware succeeds with finite terminal response 200 Hello.
cases.reason: Original private call only proved resolution without a response. Public HTTP requires terminal response.
cases.localScenario: empty middleware reaches terminal response

cases.title: should work when yielding at the end of the stack
cases.behavior: After awaiting terminal, called=true.
cases.reason: Supply finite terminal Hello; private end-of-stack Context behavior is not exported.
cases.localScenario: yielding end of stack resumes the awaiting middleware

cases.title: should reject on errors in middleware
cases.behavior: Synchronous middleware rejects with the exact ExpectedError instance.
cases.reason: Hono public onError deliberately rethrows to preserve upstream ownership; Utils fetch rejects directly.
cases.localScenario: middleware propagates ExpectedError: sync

cases.title: should keep the context
cases.behavior: All three middleware and terminal observe one object identity during request.
cases.reason: Observe actual Hono Context identities versus actual Utils Request identities; caller-provided Context equality is incompatible.
cases.localScenario: all layers retain the same per-request identity

cases.title: should catch downstream errors
cases.behavior: Downstream async throw is caught upstream; exact order [1,6,4,2,3].
cases.reason: Hono public onError rethrows so outer middleware owns recovery. Recovery returns finite Hello; additional authored synchronous variant also runs.
cases.localScenario: upstream catches downstream thrown error: async

cases.title: should compose w/ next
cases.behavior: Empty chain invokes supplied terminal exactly once.
cases.reason: Terminal Handler/route substitutes for private optional Context/Next argument; generic private Next API is not shared.
cases.localScenario: empty composition invokes caller terminal

cases.title: should handle errors in wrapped non-async functions
cases.behavior: Wrapped non-async throwing function rejects exact ExpectedError instance.
cases.reason: Public HTTP error boundary rethrows; an extra wrapper passes next without translating the thrown error.
cases.localScenario: middleware propagates ExpectedError: wrapped

cases.title: should compose w/ other compositions
cases.behavior: Nested registration/composition enters literal order [1,2,3].
cases.reason: Hono.route copies child routes; Utils.compose nests Fetch middleware. This does not claim equivalence to Hono private compose factory.
cases.localScenario: nested public composition preserves all three middleware calls

cases.title: should throw if next() is called multiple times
cases.behavior: Single middleware calling next twice rejects; terminal count=1.
cases.reason: Independently assert Hono Error/message and Utils TypeError/message; no loosened shared error message.
cases.localScenario: repeated next rejects once: single

cases.title: should return a valid middleware
cases.behavior: Nested group and outer middleware perform exactly three calls.
cases.reason: Retain literal count=3 and order [1,2,3] using published nesting APIs, not private factory identity.
cases.localScenario: nested public composition preserves all three middleware calls

cases.title: should return last return value
cases.behavior: Inner/outer post-next observations both see 2; final value is 1.
cases.reason: Native HTTP Response is returned rather than private Context; final per-request state is observed separately.
cases.localScenario: last outer state update follows both inner value observations

cases.title: should not affect the original middleware array
cases.behavior: Registration retains caller array length/function identity; later mutation cannot change selected middleware.
cases.reason: Hono public use(...input) and Utils public compose snapshot; private tuple-array representation is not shared. Mutation check is an authored strengthening.
cases.localScenario: registration leaves caller array unchanged and snapshots its middleware

cases.title: should not get stuck on the passed in next
cases.behavior: Middleware and terminal each count=1, request stays pending until owned gate released, then resolves.
cases.reason: Public terminal route/Handler replaces private passed-in Next(context,next); no generic Context dispatch signature claim. Gate and every started promise join in finally.
cases.localScenario: passed terminal stalls then resumes exactly once
